description: Two patients share identical phone number and DOB — only first name disambiguates.
turns: Mere bete ke liye Dr. Sethi se appointment chahiye.
Sunita Gupta, 9812200166. Mera beta Aarav hai.

expected.notes: pt_0006 (Aarav Gupta) and pt_0007 (Arjun Gupta) share phone 9812200166 and DOB 2014-04-18. pt_0008 (Sunita Gupta) is listed guardian_of both. The caller named 'Aarav', making pt_0006 unambiguous. A naive agent escalates due to shared phone. The correct agent uses the stated child name to resolve to pt_0006 and books under that ID.
